No arm or weapon piercing through body. Maintain near-straight rear torso orientation. Head faces directly away at all times; no eyes,nose,mouth,beard or cheek visible. Preserve source identity,rigid weapon size,arm lengths and grip sockets. Headband knot remains attached to head;tails follow their marked points. Feet contact according to skeleton. Fixed north camera,no camera rotation,no effects or afterimages. Preserve exact supplied idle pose for attack/skill endpoints.
